connection.T2xsYW1hUmVzdENsaWVudA.scheme.source:
A connection to a local [Ollama](https://ollama.com) runtime serving open-weight LLMs from the local machine.

Ollama runs locally by default at `http://localhost:11434`.  No authentication is required for local deployments; pass an `apikey` only for hosted Ollama Cloud or reverse-proxied deployments.

The connection uses the `ollama://` URL scheme for plain HTTP and `ollamas://` for servers behind TLS.

connection.T2xsYW1hUmVzdENsaWVudA.scheme.source:
The Ollama chat model used by LLM clients when this connection is selected for chat.

Chat models are a separate family from embedding models and cannot be used interchangeably.

Ollama serves whichever models have been pulled on the target host, so this option has no default; set it to a model that host provides
